title: RunnerProblem
description: application/problem+json (RFC 9457) body of a refused runner call (408, 409, 410, 413, 415, 422, 429, 507; 400 for an interrupted upload). 401 and 404 have no body.

goneReason.description: over: the job is over for good (cancelled, failed or finished), drop its checkpoints. requeued: it went back to the queue (lease, eligibility), keep them, it may be claimed again.
